note: Entries marked 'reported' reference public incidents; verify figures before citing. Others are illustrative.

bugs.title: SQL injection in login query
bugs.vulnerableCode:
query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE username='" + username + "' AND password='" + password + "'"
result = db.execute(query)
bugs.fixedCode:
query = "SELECT id, password_hash FROM users WHERE username = %s"
row = db.execute(query, (username,)).fetchone()
if row and verify_password(password, row['password_hash']):
    ...
bugs.impact: Authentication bypass and full database read access
bugs.historicalLoss: Reported: Heartland Payment Systems (2008) breach via SQL injection exposed around 130 million card numbers
bugs.lesson: Always use parameterized queries and hash passwords; never concatenate user input into SQL.

bugs.title: Floating-point arithmetic on money
bugs.fixedCode:
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP
total = Decimal('0.1') + Decimal('0.2')
balance = balance - (Decimal(amount) * Decimal('1.18')).quantize(Decimal('0.01'), ROUND_HALF_UP)
bugs.impact: Rounding drift accumulates in ledgers and breaks reconciliation
bugs.historicalLoss: Illustrative: small per-transaction rounding errors compound into unreconciled balances at scale
bugs.lesson: Use Decimal or integer minor units (paise/cents) for all currency values.

bugs.title: Missing idempotency key on payment requests
bugs.vulnerableCode:
def charge(user, amount):
    return gateway.create_charge(user, amount)
bugs.impact: Retries and double-clicks cause duplicate charges
bugs.historicalLoss: Illustrative: duplicate charges lead to refunds, chargeback fees and customer churn
bugs.lesson: Require an idempotency key for every money-moving request.

bugs.title: Hardcoded API secret in source code
bugs.fixedCode:
import os
API_KEY = os.environ['PAYMENT_API_KEY']
requests.post(url, headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {API_KEY}'})
bugs.impact: Leaked keys in git history allow attackers to move funds or read data
bugs.historicalLoss: Illustrative: leaked live keys lead to fraudulent transactions and forced key rotation
bugs.lesson: Load secrets from environment or a secrets manager and rotate any key that was ever committed.

bugs.title: Race condition in balance check (double spend)
bugs.fixedCode:
with transaction.atomic():
    acct = Account.objects.select_for_update().get(id=account.id)
    if acct.balance < amount:
        raise InsufficientFunds()
    acct.balance -= amount
    acct.save()
bugs.impact: Parallel requests can spend the same balance twice
bugs.historicalLoss: Illustrative: attackers fire many parallel withdrawals to overdraw an account
bugs.lesson: Lock the row and check-and-update inside one database transaction.

bugs.title: Server-side request forgery reaching cloud metadata
bugs.impact: Attacker makes the server fetch internal URLs and steal cloud credentials
bugs.historicalLoss: Reported: Capital One (2019) breach via SSRF led to an 80 million USD penalty from the OCC in 2020
bugs.lesson: Allowlist outbound hosts and block access to internal and metadata addresses.

bugs.title: Unsafe deployment leaving old code active
bugs.vulnerableCode: # Deploy script copies new build to 7 of 8 servers; old trading flag logic stays on the 8th
bugs.fixedCode: # Automated deploy to all nodes with verification step; remove dead feature flags; add kill switch and position limits
bugs.impact: Obsolete logic runs in production and sends unintended orders
bugs.historicalLoss: Reported: Knight Capital (2012) lost roughly 440 million USD in about 45 minutes after a faulty deployment
bugs.lesson: Automate and verify deployments, delete dead code, and add circuit breakers.

bugs.title: Unhandled division by zero crashes settlement service when no transactions arrive
bugs.vulnerableCode:
def average_ticket(total, count):
    return total / count
bugs.impact: ZeroDivisionError crashes the service overnight when traffic is zero, so morning settlements are skipped
bugs.historicalLoss: Illustrative: a nightly crash delays settlements until someone restarts the service in the morning
bugs.lesson: Guard divisions against empty inputs and return a safe default instead of raising.
